desc: The "sa" account is installed with a default null password on (1) Microsoft SQL Server 2000, (2) SQL Server 7.0, and (3) Data Engine (MSDE) 1.0, including third party packages that use these products such as (4) Tumbleweed Secure Mail (MMS) (5) Compaq Insight Manager, and (6) Visio 2000, which allows remote attackers to gain privileges, as exploited by worms such as Voyager Alpha Force and Spida.
desc_es: La cuenta ’sa’ se instala con una contraseña nula por defecto en (1) Microsoft SQL Server 2000, (2) SQL Server 7.0, y (3) Data Engine (MSDE) 1.0, incluyendo paquetes de terceros que utilizan estos productos como (4) Tumbleweed Secure Mail (MMS) (5) Compaq Insight Manager, y (6) Visio 2000, lo que permite a atacantes remotos obtener privilegios, como es explotado por gusanos como Voyager Alpha Force y Spida.
